# langsmith_tag_value (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a LangSmith tag value within a tag key, by ID or by value name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_tag_key" "environment" {
  key = "environment"
}

# Look up by value name
data "langsmith_tag_value" "production" {
  tag_key_id = data.langsmith_tag_key.environment.id
  value      = "production"
}

# Or look up by ID
data "langsmith_tag_value" "by_id" {
  tag_key_id = data.langsmith_tag_key.environment.id
  id         = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag_key_id` (String) The UUID of the parent tag key.

### Optional

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the tag value. Either `id` or `value` must be specified.
- `value` (String) The tag value. Either `id` or `value` must be specified.
- `workspace_id` (String) If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this data source.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) A description of the tag value.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
